# SuperClaude for SAP (sc4sap) — Development Rules

This file is the **index** of development rules — NOT a payload to preload. Detailed rules live in `common/` and `exceptions/`. Consult files on demand per [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](common/context-loading-protocol.md) — 4-tier model: **Tier 1** global mandatory safety baseline (always loaded by every agent: `data-extraction-policy`, `sap-version-reference`, `naming-conventions`; `context-loading-protocol` + `model-routing-rule` are orchestrator-only, read by skills), **Tier 2** role-mandatory per agent group, **Tier 3** triggered reads, **Tier 4** per-task kit. Everything referenced below is MANDATORY for every sc4sap session (agents, skills, direct user requests, pipelines).

## Development Standards — References

| Topic | Reference |
|---|---|
| Naming conventions (Z/Y prefixes, module prefix, includes, FGs, tables, DEs, DOs) | [`common/naming-conventions.md`](common/naming-conventions.md) |
| Field typing priority (Standard DE → CBO DE → new CBO DE → Data Type+Length; never `LIFNR CHAR 10`) | [`common/field-typing-rule.md`](common/field-typing-rule.md) |
| Function Module source convention (inline IMPORTING/EXPORTING/TABLES in FUNCTION statement; no placeholder, no shadow locals) | [`common/function-module-rule.md`](common/function-module-rule.md) |
| SAP version awareness (ECC vs S/4HANA — tables, TCodes, BAPIs, patterns) | [`common/sap-version-reference.md`](common/sap-version-reference.md) |
| ABAP release awareness (syntax availability per release, never emit newer features than `ABAP_RELEASE`) | [`common/abap-release-reference.md`](common/abap-release-reference.md) |
| Clean ABAP coding standards (paradigm-split) | shared baseline [`common/clean-code.md`](common/clean-code.md) + one of [`common/clean-code-oop.md`](common/clean-code-oop.md) or [`common/clean-code-procedural.md`](common/clean-code-procedural.md) chosen from the Phase 1B Paradigm dimension; also pulls in `constant-rule.md`, `text-element-rule.md`, `abap-release-reference.md` |
| Procedural FORM naming (screen-bound suffix) | [`common/procedural-form-naming.md`](common/procedural-form-naming.md) |
| OOP two-class split pattern | [`common/oop-pattern.md`](common/oop-pattern.md) |
| Include structure (Main + conditional includes) | [`common/include-structure.md`](common/include-structure.md) |
| ALV display rules | [`common/alv-rules.md`](common/alv-rules.md) |
| Tabstrip screens (STRIP_CTRL + subscreen area + tab PUSH rows, `CALL SUBSCREEN` in PBO and PAI) | [`common/screen-tabstrip.md`](common/screen-tabstrip.md) |
| OK_CODE binding pattern (one TOP variable + screen NAME + PAI dispatch; never `CASE sy-ucomm`) | [`common/ok-code-pattern.md`](common/ok-code-pattern.md) |
| SPRO lookup protocol (consultant agents, IMG/Customizing) | [`common/spro-lookup.md`](common/spro-lookup.md) |
| Customization lookup protocol (existing Z*/Y* BAdI impl, CMOD, form-exits, appends — mandatory before recommending new enhancements/extensions) | [`common/customization-lookup.md`](common/customization-lookup.md) |
| Data extraction policy (blocklist rule, `acknowledge_risk` hard rule, refusal template) | [`common/data-extraction-policy.md`](common/data-extraction-policy.md) |
| Transport client rule (every `CreateTransport` must receive explicit `client` from `.sc4sap/sap.env` SAP_CLIENT — never an implicit default) | [`common/transport-client-rule.md`](common/transport-client-rule.md) |
| Blocklist (per-category table lists) | [`exceptions/table_exception.md`](exceptions/table_exception.md) (index) + `exceptions/*.md` section files |
| Industry business-context references (14 industries) | [`industry/README.md`](industry/README.md) + `industry/*.md` |
| Country / localization references (16 countries + EU common) | [`country/README.md`](country/README.md) + `country/*.md` |
| Active modules — cross-module integration matrix (MM↔PS, SD↔CO, QM↔PP, …) | [`common/active-modules.md`](common/active-modules.md) |
| Context loading protocol (CLAUDE.md is an index; every dispatch declares its minimal context kit) | [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](common/context-loading-protocol.md) |
| Model routing (Opus for judgment / novel code; Sonnet for template + bulk writes; Haiku `sap-checker` fan-out for fetch / verify / detect) | [`common/model-routing-rule.md`](common/model-routing-rule.md) |
| Model dispatch mode (`auto` default = route per rule; `user-defined` = ask Opus / Sonnet / Haiku before each dispatch group; set via `/sc4sap:sap-option`) | [`common/model-dispatch-mode.md`](common/model-dispatch-mode.md) |

Before any work: verify `.sc4sap/config.json` exists and contains `sapVersion`, `abapRelease`, `industry`. Every recommendation, piece of generated code, and tool invocation must respect those fields.

## Critical Rules (summary — full text in referenced files)

1. **Custom objects use `Z`/`Y` prefix.** Full rules: `common/naming-conventions.md`.
2. **Match SAP version and ABAP release.** Never use S/4-only tables on ECC or syntax newer than the configured `abapRelease`. Full rules: `common/sap-version-reference.md`, `common/abap-release-reference.md`.
3. **Transport discipline.** Every change goes on a transport. Description format: `[MODULE] [Action] [Object] - [brief]`. Never release with syntax errors or inactive objects. Every `CreateTransport` call must receive an explicit `client` parameter resolved from `.sc4sap/sap.env` SAP_CLIENT (full rule: `common/transport-client-rule.md`).
4. **Activate after every change.** Run `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis` for syntax, then `GetInactiveObjects` to confirm no leftovers. Follow Clean ABAP conventions: `common/clean-code.md` (shared) + the paradigm-specific companion (`clean-code-oop.md` OR `clean-code-procedural.md`).
5. **Data extraction is gated.** Before any `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`: consult `exceptions/table_exception.md` and `common/data-extraction-policy.md`. Schema/DDIC (`GetTable`, `GetStructure`, `GetView`, `GetDataElement`, `GetDomain`) is always allowed.
6. **`acknowledge_risk` requires explicit user affirmative** (`yes` / `승인` / `authorize` / `approve` / `proceed` / `confirmed`). Ambiguous commands (`뽑아봐`, `try it`, `pull it`, `my mistake`) are NOT authorization. Per-call, per-table, per-session — never carries over. Full protocol: `common/data-extraction-policy.md` → "The `acknowledge_risk` Parameter — HARD RULE".
7. **Industry context matters.** For config analysis / business process design / Fit-Gap: load the project's `industry/<key>.md` (from `config.json` → `industry` or `sap.env` → `SAP_INDUSTRY`). If unset, ask the user.
8. **Country / localization context matters.** For tax, e-invoicing, banking, statutory reporting, date/number formats: load the project's `country/<iso>.md` (from `config.json` → `country` or `sap.env` → `SAP_COUNTRY`, ISO alpha-2 lowercase: `kr`, `us`, `de`, `eu-common`, …). Multi-country projects load every relevant file and flag cross-country touchpoints (intercompany, intra-EU VAT, transfer pricing). If unset, ask the user.

Enforcement: L1 agent instructions → L2 this file → L3 `PreToolUse` hook (`scripts/hooks/block-forbidden-tables.mjs`) → L4 MCP server upstream guard.

## Plugin Usage

### Skills (`/sc4sap:` prefix)
- `/sc4sap:setup` — Initial plugin setup + SPRO config generation (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:create-program` — Full ABAP program pipeline (Phase 0–8) with execution-mode gate (auto/manual/hybrid) and parallel Phase 4/6; auto-invokes `trust-session` at Phase 1
- `/sc4sap:create-object` — Single ABAP object creation (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — Reverse-engineer a program into a spec artifact
- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — End-user manual for one program: one HTML file, scenario steps on drawn screens with numbered callouts, check points, field reference, messages & actions, glossary, revision history; one step per A4 landscape page in print. Output `.sc4sap/manuals/<PROGRAM>-v<n>-<lang>.html` (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — Static code review (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — Business-angle side-by-side comparison of 2–5 ABAP programs sharing the same scenario but differing by module / country / persona (reader = consultant) → one editable, versioned HTML report (verdict matrix + *Differences only*, field differences, screens side by side, decision guide, English companion) `comparisons/<NAME>-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — One module's configuration documented from the live system: IMG tree, per IMG activity the real table values drawn on an SM30-style screen, customer-changed rows with their transports, configuration checks, SAP IMG documentation, consultant notes written by the module consultant agent and reviewed by `sap-critic` → one HTML file `config-docs/<MODULE>/<MODULE>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base. MM first.
- `/sc4sap:interface-mapping-spec` — Interface mapping specification as one editable HTML page in the classic template layout (cover, revision history, header, Source → Target grid with R / MAPPING, optional synchronous response block, conversion rules, extraction condition, field guide). SAP side read from DDIC / FM signature or, for new interfaces, from a `TABLE-FIELD` list or the module consultant's proposal; counterpart fields, DB types, conversion rules and scenario defaults proposed; in-page checks; versioned with English companion → `interfaces/<IF_ID>/<IF_ID>-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base
- `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` — Dump/error root-cause analysis (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` — Inventory a CBO package → save frequently-used Z objects to `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/` for reuse by `create-program` / `program-to-spec` (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — Reverse-engineer a CBO package into an End-to-End Business Process document (Markdown): auto-detected TCode entry points → AI process grouping (PR→PO→GR→IR style) → per-process narrative + Mermaid flowchart + sequenceDiagram + step tables. Auto-chains `sap-stocker` if CBO inventory missing. Progress bar at each step. Output: `processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/process-<YYYYMMDD>-<lang>.md` under the profile-resolved artifact base (`common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`), with `_state/` checkpoints for resume (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:ask-consultant` — Direct user-facing Q&A with a module consultant agent (SD/MM/FI/CO/PP/PS/PM/QM/TR/HCM/WM/TM/BW/Ariba/BC). Auto-routes by keywords, answers against the configured SAP environment. Read-only (no writes, no row extraction).
- `/sc4sap:mcp-setup` — MCP ABAP ADT server configuration guide
- `/sc4sap:sap-option` — View and edit `.sc4sap/sap.env` (credentials, industry, blocklist profile, HUD limits)
- `/sc4sap:sap-doctor` — Diagnose plugin / MCP / SAP connection health
- `/sc4sap:trust-session` — INTERNAL-ONLY — session-wide MCP permission bootstrap; direct invocation is rejected

### Agents
- Core: `sap-analyst`, `sap-architect`, `sap-code-reviewer`, `sap-critic`, `sap-debugger`, `sap-doc-specialist`, `sap-executor`, `sap-planner`, `sap-qa-tester`, `sap-writer`
- Checker: `sap-checker` — Haiku, read-only fan-out worker (`scout` / `verify` / `detect`) that returns structured lines; the main thread dispatches N of them and one Opus agent consumes the result. Used by `/sc4sap:create-program` Phase 1A scout, Phase 4 verification, Phase 6 `detect-judge`; `/sc4sap:analyze-code` size scout, large-object detect-judge, evidence verify; `/sc4sap:compare-programs` facts extraction; `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` + `/sc4sap:package-to-process` stocking scouts.
- Discovery: `sap-stocker` — CBO inventory / where-used graph / reusable object cataloging (Sonnet, R/O SAP + R/W on `.sc4sap/cbo/`). Consumed by `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj`, `/sc4sap:create-program` (CBO reuse gate), and module consultants via their `<CBO_Stocking_Delegation>` block.
- Basis: `sap-bc-consultant`
- Module consultants: `sap-sd-`, `sap-mm-`, `sap-pp-`, `sap-pm-`, `sap-qm-`, `sap-wm-`, `sap-tm-`, `sap-tr-`, `sap-fi-`, `sap-co-`, `sap-hcm-`, `sap-bw-`, `sap-ps-`, `sap-ariba-consultant`

### SPRO Config Reference
`configs/{MODULE}/` contains `spro.md`, `tcodes.md`, `bapi.md`, `tables.md`, `enhancements.md`, `workflows.md` per module. Consultant agents consult these + `common/spro-lookup.md` before IMG answers.

### MCP Server (mcp-abap-adt)
All SAP interactions go through the MCP ABAP ADT server (150+ tools):
- CRUD: `CreateClass` / `UpdateClass` / `GetClass` / `DeleteClass` (and every DDIC/runtime object type)
- Analysis: `GetAbapAST`, `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis`, `GetWhereUsed`
- Runtime: `RunUnitTest`, `GetUnitTestResult`, `RuntimeAnalyzeDump`
- System: `GetTableContents`, `GetSqlQuery` (gated — see rule 5/6 above)
- Transport: `CreateTransport`, `GetTransport`, `ListTransports`

```
**MANDATORY gate — runs as Step 0 before any file write.**

Detect whether this skill is being invoked standalone or by a parent skill:
- **Parent skill present**: the invocation is chained from `/sc4sap:create-program`, `/sc4sap:setup`, `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj`, `/sc4sap:analyze-code`, `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom`, `/sc4sap:create-object`, `/sc4sap:program-to-spec`, `/sc4sap:package-to-process`, `/sc4sap:compare-programs`, or `/sc4sap:program-to-manual`. The caller passes `parent_skill={name}` as the first argument OR the invocation appears inside another skill's execution trace in the current turn.
- **Standalone (no parent)**: invoked through the Skill tool outside any parent skill's execution, or the arguments do not identify a known parent. (A user-typed `/sc4sap:trust-session` never reaches this skill — `user-invocable: false` blocks it.)

**On standalone invocation, refuse and redirect**:

```
⚠️ /sc4sap:trust-session is an internal-only skill. Direct invocation is not allowed.

To grant session-wide permissions for an automated pipeline, run one of the following
parent skills instead (each auto-invokes trust-session at entry):

Skills that read or produce project-local artifacts must adopt this pattern:

- `/sc4sap:create-program` — writes `program/<name>/{platform,interview,spec,plan,report,...}.md`
- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — reads existing programs, writes spec.md / spec.xlsx
- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — writes review report
- `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` — writes `cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/{index,inventory}.md`
- `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — writes `comparisons/<NAME>-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `.md` source + `<NAME>-<lang>.history.json` + `_img/` / `_assets/` screen pictures
- `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — writes `config-docs/<MODULE>/<MODULE>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `snapshot.json` + `_cache.json` (read cache) + `notes/` (consultant notes, review)
- `/sc4sap:interface-mapping-spec` — writes `interfaces/<IF_ID>/<IF_ID>-v<n>-<lang>.{json,html}` + `_i18n/` (companion texts); reads / writes `interfaces/project.json` (cover, ID pattern, code lists) and `interfaces/_answers/`
- `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — reads `cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/inventory.json` (cross-view hit → refuse on a `sap_version` mismatch, else ask), writes `processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/{process-*, bpml-*, _state/}`
- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — writes `manuals/<PROGRAM>-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `<PROGRAM>-<lang>.history.json` + `_src/` / `_draft/` manual.json
- `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` — writes audit reports
- `/sc4sap:create-object` — writes nothing long-term (transient state only)
- Setup / sap-option — manage profile files themselves; outside this pattern

Each affected skill's SKILL.md should explicitly state "uses multi-profile artifact resolution per `common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`" so the LLM picks up the rule at dispatch time.

## Invariants

- **Never** write to `<project>/.sc4sap/` directly when `active-profile.txt` exists — always scope under `work/<alias>/`.
- **Never** write to a cross-view path — cross-view is read-only by definition.

---
name: config-to-document
description: Document one module's configuration as it is in the connected SAP system — one HTML file that follows the module's IMG tree, shows every IMG activity with its real table values drawn on an SM30-style screen, marks the rows customer transports changed (with the transport history), runs configuration checks and adds SAP's own IMG documentation. MM first; other modules through the same pipeline.
model: inherit
---

# SC4SAP Configuration → Document

Reads the module's IMG structure and configuration tables from the live system and writes **one HTML file**: an IMG tree with search and status filters on the left, one page per IMG activity (screen drawing with the real values, the full value table, customer changes, checks, SAP documentation) and a checklist panel on the right.

<Purpose>
Consultants, key users and auditors need to know how a system is set up — not how SAP describes the module in general. This skill answers "what is configured here, what did the project change, and what looks wrong" from the system itself. GUI screenshots are not possible, so the screens are drawn with the shared screen renderer (the same drawing as `program-to-manual`), filled with the values read from the tables.

---
name: smartform-preview
description: Draw the expected print of a SmartForm as a JPG (plus the HTML it is drawn from) — windows at their real mm positions, SmartStyle fonts, template / table grids with borders and shading, SE78 graphics such as logos and signatures, loops with sample rows — with invented sample values in place of the &fields&, sized to the real field types. Reports the cells and windows whose content gets cut off.
model: inherit

# SC4SAP SmartForm → Print Preview

Reads one SmartForm from the connected system and draws what a printed page will look like, without running the print program: **one JPG and one HTML page** (A4 in mm). Field symbols (`&HEADER-NAME1&`) are filled with invented sample values that fit the field types read from the DDIC, so the picture shows realistic widths — and the places where the form cuts text off.

<Purpose>
Consultants and key users need to see a form before test data exists, to review a layout change, or to attach "expected output" to a spec. SMARTFORMS test output needs a driver program and real documents; this skill only needs the form itself.
</Purpose>

<Response_Prefix>Every response triggered by this skill MUST begin with `[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Response Prefix Convention. This skill dispatches no agents (`Dispatched: none`).</Response_Prefix>

<Team_Mode>**No teamMode integration.** Reading and drawing are scripted; the main thread writes the sample values.</Team_Mode>

<Use_When>
- "SmartForm preview", "what does this form print", "expected output of ZXX_FORM", "스마트폼 미리보기", "출력물 예상 이미지", "スマートフォームのプレビュー"
- A spec or test case needs a picture of the form output
- Before / after a layout change of a form
</Use_When>

<Do_Not_Use_When>
- The user wants to **change** the form — this skill is read-only; SmartForm editing is not supported
- SAPscript forms (SE71) or Adobe forms (SFP) — only SmartForms
- The user wants the output with **real document data** — refuse (see Data_Rules) and offer invented values
</Do_Not_Use_When>

<Decisions_Fixed>
| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Source | MCP `GetSmartFormContent` (active version, logon language) → `<form>.content.json` in the MCP output directory |
| Values | Invented by the main thread from the field types (`GetStructure` / `GetDataElement` / `GetTable`), never read from documents |
| Loops / tables | 3 sample rows unless the user asks for more; a row count that overflows MAIN shows where the page would break |
| Pages | First page; `firstPage` / `lastPage` windows all shown (one-page document) |
| Cut-off text | Drawn cut off, as SAP prints it (cell clips, no wrap); listed in the report |
| Borders / shading | As stored in the form — gaps in borders are real |
| Output | `<artifact-base>/smartforms/<FORM>/<FORM>-preview.{jpg,html}` + `values.json` (artifact base per [`../../common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`](../../common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md)) |
</Decisions_Fixed>

<Prerequisites>
- MCP tool `GetSmartFormContent` and, on the SAP side, FM `ZMCP_SSF_CONTENT` with dispatcher action `SSF_CONTENT`. An "install" error from the tool → stop and point to `/sc4sap:setup` (DEV-only helpers); never install SAP objects from this skill.
- Chrome, Edge or Chromium for the JPG (`SC4SAP_CHROME` overrides the path). Without a browser the HTML is still written.
</Prerequisites>

<Workflow>
Paths: `<base>` = artifact base, `<out>` = `<base>/smartforms/<FORM>`, `<content>` = the `files.content` path the tool returns.

**Step 1 — Target.** Form name from ARGUMENTS; if missing ask once. Uppercase it.

**Step 2 — Read the form.** `GetSmartFormContent(form_name, summary: true)` — the summary lists windows, data declarations, `symbols`, graphics, styles and `files.content` (the full result on disk). Read only the summary; never load the content file into the conversation.
- `graphics[].error` or `dynamicReferences` (keys set at print time) → the drawing shows a box there; say so in the result.
- If `<out>/values.json` exists from an earlier run, offer to reuse it (Recommended) or write new values.

**Step 3 — Where each symbol prints.**
```
node scripts/smartform/build-preview.mjs symbols "<content>"
```
→ per symbol: its declaration (`HEADER` → type `ZXX_S_HEAD`), every place it prints (window, paragraph, font pt, cell width mm, in a loop or not).

**Step 4 — Field types.** For every declaration type behind a symbol: `GetStructure` (structures, table lines), `GetDataElement` (single fields such as `CHAR100`, `STCEG`); `GetTable` when the type is a table. Parallel calls. Keep per field: data type, length, decimals, description.

**Step 5 — Sample values** → write `<out>/values.json` with the `Write` tool:
```json
{ "form": "ZXX_FORM", "defaultParagraph": "AA", "rows": 3,
  "values": { "HEADER-NAME1": "Northwind Trading Co., Ltd.",
              "GS_ITEM-MATNR": ["100234", "100235", "100512"] } }
```
- Write values **as printed**: dates and numbers in the user's format (country file / `config.json` → `country`; KR / US style `1,250.000`, DE style `1.250,000`), currency amounts with their decimals, units as their external code.
- Realistic lengths: names and texts typically 50–90 % of the field length; keys at their usual length (`4500001234`, `0010004567`). A symbol inside a loop or table gets an array, one value per row; totals add up.
- Values hang together: same buyer in buyer and ship-to when the form implies it, item amounts = quantity × price, a total that matches.
- `defaultParagraph`: the paragraph for lines formatted `*` (the style's standard paragraph is not in the content). Take the paragraph of the neighbouring label of the same kind (e.g. the title cell next to it); say which one in the result. Keep the choice in `values.json` for later runs.
- System symbols (`SFSY-PAGE`, `SFSY-FORMPAGES`) default to 1; set them only for a different picture.

**Step 6 — Build.**
```
node scripts/smartform/build-preview.mjs build "<content>" --values "<out>/values.json" --out-dir "<out>" [--rows N] [--mark]
```
`--mark` tints the sample values yellow (for review); unfilled symbols always show as blue `&NAME&` placeholders. The JSON report lists `filled`, `unfilled`, `overflow` (cells / windows whose content does not fit), `approximations` and the `defaultParagraph` used.

**Step 7 — Check and show.** `Read` the JPG and look at it before answering: overlapping windows, empty windows, missing graphics, symbols left blue. Fix `values.json` and rebuild for value problems; report layout findings — never "fix" the form's layout in the drawing.
</Workflow>

<Data_Rules>
Only the form definition, styles, graphics and DDIC metadata are read. **Sample values are invented** — never business data, never real customer, vendor or company names, never real tax numbers or addresses of real parties. Do not call `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` to fill the form; a request for "the real output of document X" is refused: say the preview uses invented values and the real output comes from the print program (e.g. the output type's processing program or SMARTFORMS test).
</Data_Rules>

<Output_Format>
```
SmartForm preview: ZXX_FORM  (page %PAGE1, A4 portrait)
Windows: 7 · Graphics: 2 (logo, signature) · Symbols: 30 filled, 0 left blank · Sample rows: 3
Cut off as printed (4): "Purchase Order No." (%TEXT24), "(Unit)" (%TEXT45, %TEXT50), …
Window overflow: %WINDOW4 — graphic 27.2 mm in a 25 mm window
Standard paragraph: AA assumed for '*' lines
JPG:  .sc4sap/work/DEV/smartforms/ZXX_FORM/ZXX_FORM-preview.jpg
HTML: .sc4sap/work/DEV/smartforms/ZXX_FORM/ZXX_FORM-preview.html
Values: .sc4sap/work/DEV/smartforms/ZXX_FORM/values.json

Next: "10 rows", "other values", "mark the sample values", "show the second page"
```
Reply in the user's language; show the JPG to the user when the client can display images.
</Output_Format>

<Limits>
- One page is drawn (the first). Further pages, page breaks after MAIN overflows, and `NEXTPAGE` flows are listed, not drawn.
- Field conditions (`condition` other than first / last page) and alternatives: the node is shown / the first branch is drawn; listed under `approximations`.
- Address nodes and include texts with a key set at print time are drawn as labelled boxes.
- Text in a template / table cell is clipped on one line; SAP's own wrapping inside a cell is not imitated. Window text wraps at the window width.
- Page formats other than A4 are drawn as A4 (listed).
</Limits>

<MCP_Tools_Used>
- `GetSmartFormContent` (`summary: true`)
- `GetStructure`, `GetDataElement`, `GetTable`, `GetDomain` (field types only)
</MCP_Tools_Used>

<Files>
- `scripts/smartform/build-preview.mjs` — `symbols` (where each symbol prints) and `build` (HTML + JPG + report)
</Files>

<Related_Skills>
- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — the print program's specification (attach the preview as expected output)
- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — user manual of the print program
</Related_Skills>

lines: -> Claude Code plugin for SAP ABAP development — SAP ECC / S/4HANA On-Premise / S/4HANA Cloud (Public & Private)

-SuperClaude for SAP transforms Claude Code into a full-stack SAP development assistant. It connects to your SAP system via the [MCP ABAP ADT server](https://github.com/babamba2/abap-mcp-adt-powerup) (150+ tools) to create, read, update, and delete ABAP objects directly — classes, function modules, reports, CDS views, Dynpro, GUI status, and more.
-| 🔌 **Auto MCP Install** | `abap-mcp-adt-powerup` is auto-installed, configured, and connection-tested during `/sc4sap:setup`. No manual MCP wiring. |

-| 🌐 **Multi-Environment Profiles (Dev / QA / Prod)** | Register multiple SAP systems per company (e.g. `KR-DEV`, `KR-QA`, `KR-PRD`, `US-DEV`) and hot-switch between them in-session via `/sc4sap:sap-option`. **QA and Prod profiles are auto-protected**: a 2-layer defense (PreToolUse hook + MCP-server guard) blocks `Create*/Update*/Delete*`, `CreateTransport`, and runtime code execution tools — bypassing the hook does not bypass enforcement. Passwords are stored in the **OS keychain** (`@napi-rs/keyring` — Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / libsecret) so `.sc4sap/` never leaks secrets to git. Artifacts (specs, CBO catalogs, audits) are isolated per profile with read-only cross-view so QA sessions can inspect Dev-produced specs without contaminating them. |

-| 🏗️ **Formatted Auto Program Maker** | Builds ABAP programs end-to-end: Main + conditional Includes (OOP/Procedural), full ALV + Docking, Dynpro + GUI Status, mandatory Text Elements, ABAP Unit tests — platform-aware (ECC / S4 On-Prem / Cloud). |
-| 🔍 **Program Analyze** | Read any ABAP object via MCP, run Clean ABAP / performance / security review, or reverse-engineer into Functional/Technical Spec (Markdown/Excel). |

-| 🧪 **Analyze Code** | `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — dedicated static review pass (`sap-code-reviewer`): Clean ABAP, performance, security, SAP standard compliance. Severity-ranked findings with concrete fix suggestions. |

-| 🔀 **Compare Programs** | `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — side-by-side business comparison of 2–5 ABAP programs that share the same scenario but split by module (MM/CO), country (KR/EU), or persona (controller/warehouse). Consultant-facing editable HTML report across 10 configurable dimensions — coloured verdict matrix with a *Differences only* switch, field-by-field differences, screens drawn side by side, decision guide, versions + English companion. |

-| ⚙️ **Config → Document** | `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — one module's configuration documented as it is in the connected system (MM first). One offline HTML file that follows the IMG tree: per IMG activity the real table values drawn on an SM30-style screen, rows changed by customer transports with their transport history, configuration checks, SAP's IMG documentation, and consultant notes written by the module consultant agent and reviewed by `sap-critic`. Read-only on SAP; an in-page edit mode lets the consultant correct the notes, values and change history and hand the file back for the next version. |

-| 🔌 **Interface Mapping Spec** | `/sc4sap:interface-mapping-spec` — interface mapping specification as one editable HTML page in the classic template layout: cover, revision history, Source → Target field grid with conversion-rule and MAPPING columns, synchronous response block, extraction condition, field guide. Built for new interfaces: scenario presets, SAP fields from a `TABLE-FIELD` list or the module consultant's proposal (checked against DDIC) — or read from an existing table, structure, view or RFC — with the counterpart side, DB types and conversion rules proposed. In-page checks (missing items, truncation, type and key mismatches, unmapped fields), Excel paste, versions with revision history, English companion, refresh when the SAP structure changes. |

-| 🗺️ **Package → Process** | `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — reverse-engineer a CBO package into an **end-to-end business-process** document: auto-detected TCode entry points → AI process grouping (PR→PO→GR→IR) → per-process narrative + Mermaid flowchart / sequence diagram + step tables. Auto-chains `sap-stocker` when CBO inventory is missing. → `.sc4sap/processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/`. |
-| 🩺 **Maintenance Diagnosis** | Operational triage loop: ST22 dumps, SM02 system messages, /IWFND/ERROR_LOG, profiler traces, logs, where-used graphs — all from Claude. |
-| ♻️ **CBO Reuse (Brownfield Accelerator)** | Inventory a Z-package once — `create-program` / `program-to-spec` prefer reusing existing CBO assets over duplicates. |

-| 🧷 **CBO Extension Awareness (CMOD / GGB0·1 / BTE / VOFM / BAdI / APPEND)** | Inventories user-exits (CMOD), validations & substitutions (GGB0/GGB1), BTE function modules, VOFM routines (requirements / formulas / data transfer), BAdI implementations, and APPEND structures. `create-program` / BAPI flows prefer existing Extension fields (e.g. BAPI `EXTENSIONIN` / table appends) over new CBOs; dump & incident diagnosis inspects Extension points as first-class suspects. |
-| 🏭 **Industry Context** | 14 industry reference files (retail, fashion, cosmetics, tire, automotive, pharma, F&B, chemical, electronics, construction, steel, utilities, banking, public-sector). |
-| 🌏 **Country / Localization** | 15 per-country files + EU-common (KR/JP/CN/US/DE/GB/FR/IT/ES/NL/BR/MX/IN/AU/SG). e-invoicing, banking, payroll, tax localization. |
-| 🧩 **Active-Module Awareness** | Cross-module integration hints: MM + PS active → auto-suggest WBS fields on MM CBOs; SD + CO active → CO-PA derivation. [Details →](common/active-modules.md) |

-| 🤝 **Module Consultation** | `sap-analyst` / `sap-critic` / `sap-planner` / `sap-architect` delegate to 14 module consultants + 1 BC consultant when business judgement is needed. Users can also ask a module consultant directly via `/sc4sap:ask-consultant` — auto-routes SD/MM/FI/CO/PP/PS/PM/QM/TR/HCM/WM/TM/BW/Ariba/BC by keywords, answers against the configured SAP environment (version, industry, country, active modules), read-only. |

-| ⚡ **Per-Phase Model Routing** | Every skill's main thread follows your session model (`model: inherit`) while delegating heavy work to specialized agents (Opus for novel ABAP generation, cross-module synthesis, and incident triage; Sonnet for facts extraction; Haiku for report rendering). No skill switches the main thread, so your model choice holds and the prompt cache is never re-written mid-session; per-phase `Agent()` dispatches run on their declared tier. Model choice is visible in every response prefix + per-phase banner (e.g. `▶ phase=3 (writer-spec) · agent=sap-writer · model=Opus`). Full matrix — per-skill, per-phase — in [docs/skill-model-architecture.md](docs/skill-model-architecture.md). |

-- 🎯 **[Features Deep-Dive →](docs/FEATURES.md)** — 26 agents, 14 skills, MCP tools, RFC backends, hooks, data-extraction policy

-| 🔌 **자동 MCP 설치** | `/sc4sap:setup` 중 `abap-mcp-adt-powerup` 자동 설치/설정/연결테스트. 수동 MCP 배선 불필요. |

-| 🌐 **다중 환경 프로파일 (Dev / QA / Prod)** | 회사별·티어별로 여러 SAP 시스템(`KR-DEV`, `KR-QA`, `KR-PRD`, `US-DEV` 등)을 등록하고 `/sc4sap:sap-option` 으로 세션 중에 즉시 전환. **QA / Prod 프로파일은 자동 읽기전용 보호**: PreToolUse 훅과 MCP 서버 가드 2계층이 `Create*/Update*/Delete*`, `CreateTransport`, 코드 실행 도구를 차단 — 훅을 우회해도 서버 단에서 여전히 거부됨. 비밀번호는 **OS 자격 증명 저장소** (`@napi-rs/keyring` — Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / libsecret) 에 보관되어 `.sc4sap/` 가 git 에 시크릿을 누출할 위험이 없음. 산출물(스펙, CBO 카탈로그, 감사)은 프로파일별로 격리되며 읽기전용 크로스뷰를 지원 — QA 세션이 Dev 에서 만든 스펙을 오염시키지 않고 참조 가능. |
-| 🏗️ **자동 프로그램 생성기** | ABAP 프로그램 엔드-투-엔드 생성: Main + Include 컨벤션, OOP/Procedural, 풀 ALV + Docking, Dynpro + GUI 스테이터스, Text Elements, ABAP Unit — 플랫폼 인식(ECC / S4 On-Prem / Cloud). |
-| 🔍 **프로그램 분석** | MCP로 ABAP 객체 읽기 → Clean ABAP / 성능 / 보안 리뷰, 또는 Functional/Technical Spec 역공학 (Markdown/Excel). |
-| 🧪 **코드 분석** | `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — `sap-code-reviewer` 전용 정적 리뷰: Clean ABAP / 성능 / 보안 / SAP 표준 준수. 심각도별 이슈와 구체적 수정 제안. |

-| 🔀 **프로그램 비교** | `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — 같은 비즈니스 시나리오를 공유하지만 모듈(MM/CO)·국가(KR/EU)·Persona(컨트롤러/창고)로 분화된 2~5개 ABAP 프로그램을 컨설턴트 관점에서 10개 차원으로 비교 → 편집 가능한 HTML 리포트(색상 판정 매트릭스·차이만 보기, 필드 차이표, 화면 나란히 비교, 의사결정 가이드, 버전 관리 + 영어판). |

IMG 트리를 따르는 오프라인 HTML 파일 하나: IMG 액티비티별 실제 테이블 값을 SM30 스타일 화면으로 그림, 고객 트랜스포트로 변경된 행과 트랜스포트 이력, 설정 점검, SAP IMG 문서, 모듈 컨설턴트 에이전트가 쓰고 `sap-critic`이 검토한 컨설턴트 노트. -  if exists(legacy): return { path: legacy, from: null, crossView: false }

---
name: sc4sap plugin — 3-location sync when patching
description: When patching sc4sap plugin code, keep project source + marketplace + user cache in sync (user is plugin author, publishes from project folder)
type: reference
originSessionId: 624e4d17-84e6-4cca-a52f-34db7cd7ad7e
---
User authors the sc4sap plugin. When patching plugin code (bridge, scripts, hooks, skills), THREE locations must stay in sync:

1. **Project source (distribution source-of-truth)** — `C:/Users/pssps/Documents/Projects/sc4sap_project/sc4sap/`
   - This is what gets published to the marketplace.
   - All new fixes MUST land here first (for git/CHANGELOG).
2. **Marketplace copy (install-time source)** — `C:/Users/pssps/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/sc4sap/`
   - What Claude Code ships into the cache when the plugin is enabled/updated.
3. **Cache (runtime)** — `C:/Users/pssps/.claude/plugins/cache/sc4sap/sc4sap/<version>/`
   - What actually runs. A fresh plugin install copies from marketplace → cache, overwriting ad-hoc patches here.

**Patching workflow**:
- Edit project source first.
- Mirror to marketplace (for install-time correctness).
- Mirror to cache (to take effect in the running session — otherwise user must `/reload-plugins` or restart).
- `diff` all three at the end — they should match exactly.

**Why not just cache?** Cache is blown away on plugin update. Project source drives git + publish; marketplace is the Claude Code-facing source.

**Related**: `bridge/mcp-server.cjs` previously only checked legacy `<project>/.sc4sap/sap.env` and `<plugin>/.sc4sap/sap.env`, missing the multi-profile path (`<project>/.sc4sap/active-profile.txt` → `~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/sap.env`). Patched 2026-04-21 in all three locations to resolve via active-profile first, with legacy paths as fallback.

**Which `<version>` folder runs (2026-10-14):** Claude Code launches the folder named by `installPath` in `~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json` (user scope), not the newest-looking folder name. Until 2026-10-14 it pointed at `0.6.14`, whose *contents* had been synced up to 0.6.35 / MCP 4.8.12, while folders `0.6.32`/`0.6.34`/`0.6.35` were older or had no vendor. On 2026-10-14 it was renamed: `0.6.35` = copy of the running folder + HEAD `c4d5d21` overlay, registry now points to `0.6.35` (backups: `installed_plugins.json.bak-20261014`, `cache/.../0.6.35.bak-20261014`; old `0.6.14` kept for rollback). Mirror target = the folder in `installPath`; check it before every sync and after a version bump.

content.text:
예시 값이 들어간 미리보기를 만들었고, 같은 과정을 `/sc4sap:smartform-preview` 스킬로 만들었습니다. 스킬로 실행해 보는 건 Claude Code를 재시작한 뒤에 가능하고, 커밋은 아직 하지 않았습니다.

**예시 값 미리보기**
- 파일: `.sc4sap/work/HKT-DEV/smartforms/ZMMM21270/ZMMM21270-preview.jpg`
- `&GS_ITEM-MATNR&` 같은 자리에 지어낸 값이 들어갑니다. 예: `100234`, `Curing bladder 205/55R16`, `1,250.000`, `22,260.00`.
- 값의 길이와 형식은 DDIC에서 읽은 필드 타입(`ZMMS21270/1/2`)에 맞췄습니다. 예시 행 3줄의 금액을 더하면 합계와 맞습니다.
- 실제 문서 데이터는 읽지 않고, 회사·거래처 이름도 모두 지어낸 것입니다.
- 잘리는 부분은 실제 인쇄본처럼 그대로 잘려 나옵니다: `Purchase Order No.`, `(Unit)`, `NCV (No Commercial Value):`. 서명 그래픽은 윈도우보다 커서 110% 넘친다고 보고서에 나옵니다.

**스킬 동작 순서**
1. `GetSmartFormContent`로 폼, 스타일, 그래픽을 읽습니다.
2. 각 `&필드&`가 어디에 몇 pt, 몇 mm 칸으로 찍히는지 정리합니다.
3. DDIC에서 필드 타입을 읽습니다.
4. 타입과 칸 크기에 맞는 예시 값을 `values.json`에 씁니다.
5. HTML과 JPG를 만들고, 잘리는 칸과 넘치는 윈도우를 보고합니다.

다시 실행할 때는 `values.json`을 다시 쓸 수 있고, "10 rows"처럼 행 수만 바꿔 다시 만들 수도 있습니다.

**바뀐 것**
- **MCP `GetSmartFormContent`**:
  - 폼 인터페이스와 전역 데이터의 타입을 함께 돌려줍니다.
  - 전체 결과를 `<form>.content.json` 파일로 저장합니다.
  - `summary: true`를 주면 요약만 답합니다. 이전에는 결과가 98k자라 출력 한도를 넘었습니다.
  - 테스트 32개 통과, 실행 중인 캐시 폴더에 반영했습니다.
- **플러그인**:
  - 추가: 스킬(`SKILL.md` 128줄), `scripts/smartform/build-preview.mjs`, 테스트.
  - 등록: `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/FEATURES.md`, README 4개 언어.
  - 테스트 498개 모두 통과했고, 마켓플레이스와 캐시 0.6.35에 복사했습니다. 그 전에 두 곳의 파일이 커밋된 버전과 같은지 확인했습니다.
- JPG 변환은 이제 Chrome이 직접 하므로 Windows 전용 변환 단계가 없습니다. Chrome이 없으면 Edge나 Chromium을 씁니다.

**남은 점**
- 기본 문단(`*`)은 여전히 SAP에서 읽지 못합니다. 지금은 `values.json`에 `defaultParagraph: "AA"`로 적어 두었습니다. 정확히 하려면 SAP 쪽 FM이 스타일의 표준 문단도 돌려줘야 하는데, SAP 객체를 바꾸는 일이라 하지 않았습니다.
- `sc4sap_project/smartform-preview-render.js`는 플러그인 스크립트로 대체돼서 지워도 됩니다.
- `scripts/config/*`의 커밋 안 된 변경은 이 작업 전부터 있던 것이라 건드리지 않았고, 이번 커밋에도 넣지 않겠습니다.

재시작 후 `/sc4sap:smartform-preview ZMMM21270`으로 한 번 실행해 보시면, 실제 도구 호출로 `content.json`이 만들어지는 것까지 확인하겠습니다. 그다음 CHANGELOG를 쓰고 두 저장소(sc4sap, MCP)에 커밋하면 될까요?

content.content:
originSessionId: 21e03650-294e-4f69-aaef-74c569183474
modified: 2026-09-29T23:29:06.682Z
---
When creating any `git commit` in `sc4sap_project` (or any repo where `entire` is enabled), the commit message MUST include an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer in the trailer block (next to / below `Co-Authored-By:`).

**Why:** `entire attach <session-id>` only registers checkpoint metadata in entire's DB and prints "Copy to your commit message to attach: Entire-Checkpoint: <id>". It does NOT automatically amend the commit to add the trailer (because last commit may already be pushed). The trailer is the chain mechanism — without it on a commit, entire's session ↔ commit linkage breaks for that commit and every subsequent one in the chain.

**How to apply:**
- Before authoring a commit, run `entire sessions list` (or `entire status`) and grab the active session's `checkpoint <id>` field.
- Append `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` as a trailer line in the commit message, on its own line in the trailer block.
- Reuse the same checkpoint ID for every commit in the same Claude Code session — `entire attach` only mints a new checkpoint when there's no checkpoint registered for the session yet.
- If the project active branch is shared (NO force-push policy) and a commit was already pushed without the trailer, do NOT try to fix via `entire attach` afterwards — it will `git commit --amend` the last commit silently and rewrite hash, forcing a reset-to-origin to recover.

**Real incident (2026-04-26):** Commit 1f4c5bf (program-to-spec PNG path fix) was authored without the trailer despite user having run `entire attach 21e03650...` earlier in the session. Result: trailer-less commit pushed to active/backup/main, and a follow-up `entire attach` silently amended local 1f4c5bf → f7615b7 forcing a hash divergence that had to be reset (force-push blocked by shared-branch policy). Net effect: that commit is permanently un-tracked by entire on origin.

**Safe pattern when the session has no checkpoint yet (worked 2026-09-30):** commit first (unpushed), then `entire attach <session-id> -f` — it amends only that unpushed commit with the trailer and mints the checkpoint; reuse the ID for later commits/merge. Never attach while HEAD is an already-pushed commit.

Quick template for commits in this project:
```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Entire-Checkpoint: <fetch via `entire sessions list`>
```

When creating any `git commit` in `sc4sap_project` (or any repo where `entire` is enabled), the commit message MUST include an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer in the trailer block (next to / below `Co-Authored-By:`).

**Why:** `entire attach <session-id>` only registers checkpoint metadata in entire's DB and prints "Copy to your commit message to attach: Entire-Checkpoint: <id>". It does NOT automatically amend the commit to add the trailer (because last commit may already be pushed). The trailer is the chain mechanism — without it on a commit, entire's session ↔ commit linkage breaks for that commit and every subsequent one in the chain.

**How to apply:**
- Before authoring a commit, run `entire sessions list` (or `entire status`) and grab the active session's `checkpoint <id>` field.
- Append `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` as a trailer line in the commit message, on its own line in the trailer block.
- Reuse the same checkpoint ID for every commit in the same Claude Code session — `entire attach` only mints a new checkpoint when there's no checkpoint registered for the session yet.
- If the project active branch is shared (NO force-push policy) and a commit was already pushed without the trailer, do NOT try to fix via `entire attach` afterwards — it will `git commit --amend` the last commit silently and rewrite hash, forcing a reset-to-origin to recover.

**Real incident (2026-04-26):** Commit 1f4c5bf (program-to-spec PNG path fix) was authored without the trailer despite user having run `entire attach 21e03650...` earlier in the session. Result: trailer-less commit pushed to active/backup/main, and a follow-up `entire attach` silently amended local 1f4c5bf → f7615b7 forcing a hash divergence that had to be reset (force-push blocked by shared-branch policy). Net effect: that commit is permanently un-tracked by entire on origin.

**Safe pattern when the session has no checkpoint yet (worked 2026-09-30):** commit first (unpushed), then `entire attach <session-id> -f` — it amends only that unpushed commit with the trailer and mints the checkpoint; reuse the ID for later commits/merge. Never attach while HEAD is an already-pushed commit.

Quick template for commits in this project:
```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Entire-Checkpoint: <fetch via `entire sessions list`>
```

# Changelog

All notable changes to **SuperClaude for SAP (sc4sap)** will be documented in this file.
Format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/); versioning follows [SemVer](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.6.40] — 2026-10-16

### Added — `config-to-document`

- What the customer BAdI implementations do: the extraction reads every implementing class (and the Z includes it branches into, two levels deep) and splits it per method — code or empty, size, the function modules, tables read and changed, classes and includes it calls. The module consultant writes a summary and one line per method with code, `sap-critic` checks them against the source, one revision (`scripts/config/badi-notes.mjs`, prompt § 6). The BAdI card shows them under each implementation with the method table and the source (folded).
- IMG activities that only open SE18 / SE19 name their BAdIs in the documentation, not in `CUS_ACTEXT`: those names count when the system knows them as a BAdI, so implementations such as invoice-verification BAdIs appear on their activity.
- Value lists per column: the ⓘ popup and the column meanings list the values a column can take with SAP's text — the domain's fixed values, else the keys of its check table with the text of its language-keyed text table (TVFK → TVFKT), never a user-name column; up to 300 values.
- What each fixed value of a column does: `scripts/config/values.mjs` batches the domains behind the shown columns (fixed values with the document-language and English SAP text, F1, rows using each value), the module consultant writes one line per value (`DOMAIN:VALUE = meaning`), `sap-critic` corrects, and the reviewed meanings go to a knowledge base shared by every module and system (`~/.sc4sap/kb/values/<lang>.json`). The value list in the ⓘ popup shows them in a "Meaning" column; a document-language SAP text that is a mistranslation, a literal rendering or untranslated is called out there. The snapshot keeps the English domain texts for this (`domainsEn`).

### Fixed — `config-to-document`

- Customer rows were under-counted on busy tables: the customer transport keys (E071K) of a table were read once, up to 5000 rows, so on per-plant tables (storage locations, order type parameters …) rows changed by later requests were not marked as customer rows. The keys are now read in pages by request number.
- The extraction's read cache (`_cache.json`) is written one entry per line: with the transport keys read in full it grew past the longest string `JSON.stringify` can build, and the run ended without writing the snapshot. A cache from an earlier version is still read.
---

# Changelog

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- **`GetSmartFormLayout`** (read-only, on-premise and legacy systems): page and window layout of a SmartForm. Per page the format, orientation, next page, CPI / LPI and style; per window its type (MAIN, SECONDARY, ...), position and size as stored (value + unit) and converted to millimetres (CM, MM, IN, PT, TW, and LN / CH through the page LPI / CPI). Reads the active version (a form that was never activated is read from its saved version and `active` is false). `language` takes a 1-character SAP key or a 2-letter ISO code. Needs the new `ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT` FM and the `SSF_LAYOUT` dispatcher branch; without them the tool answers with an install hint.

## ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT + dispatcher action SSF_LAYOUT (GetSmartFormLayout)

Read-only page / window layout of one SmartForm for the MCP tool `GetSmartFormLayout`. Works on BASIS 7.31 (SOAP RFC backend) and 7.40 (OData backend); the server reaches it through `ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH`, so no new OData function import is needed.

**Sources:**
- `zmcp_ssf_layout.abap` — FM `ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT`, one source for 7.31 and 7.40 (no inline declarations, no `/UI2/CL_JSON`, no `ZCL_MCP_JSON`; the JSON is built in the FM). The `SSF_LAYOUT_*` FORMs at the end of the file go into the same function group.
- `zmcp_adt_dispatch_ssf_layout_branch.abap` — two snippets: A for the 7.31 dispatcher (`ZCL_MCP_JSON`), B for the ECC / 7.40 dispatcher (`/UI2/CL_JSON`). Each is one `WHEN 'SSF_LAYOUT'.` line for the `CASE` plus a `FORM ssf_layout` to append.

**Interface of ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT:**
| Parameter | Type | Direction | Description |
|-----------|------|-----------|-------------|
| IV_FORMNAME | TDSFNAME | Import | SmartForm name |
| IV_LANGUAGE | SPRAS | Import (optional) | Form language; empty → master language of the form |
| EV_SUBRC | SYSUBRC | Export | 0 = ok, 4 = form not found, 8 = other error |
| EV_MESSAGE | STRING | Export | Error / info message |
| EV_RESULT | STRING | Export | JSON: variants → pages → windows, coordinates raw with their units |

It reads `STXFADM` and the Form Builder object model (`CL_SSF_FB_SMART_FORM->LOAD` in display mode, page tree nodes, the window node's output attributes). Text contents, program lines, global data and the form interface are never returned.

**Install (per system, each step needs a transport and the user's OK):**
1. Create FM `ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT` in function group `ZMCP_ADT_UTILS` — **not** remote-enabled — with the source of `zmcp_ssf_layout.abap`; activate. Where ADT source writes fail (some 7.31 systems), create it in SE37.
2. On 7.31, check in SE24 that `CL_SSF_FB_NODE` (`OBJ`, `OUTATTR`, `SUCC`), `CL_SSF_FB_PAGE` (`NEXTPAGE`, `PAGEORTN`, `PRINTMODE`), `CL_SSF_FB_WINDOW` (`WTYPE`, `WLEVEL`) and `CL_SSF_FB_OUTATTR` (`WLEFT` … `U_WHEIGHT`, `WFRAME`, `WSHADING`, `WEMPTY`) have these public attributes.
3. Read and back up the **live** `ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH` (the repo copies can be older), then add the snippet that matches the release: A (7.31) or B (7.40). Activate.
4. Test with `GetSmartFormLayout` on a known form and on a name that does not exist (expect "not found").

Until step 3 is done the tool answers with an install hint (`Unknown action: SSF_LAYOUT`).

content.content:
FUNCTION zmcp_ssf_content
  IMPORTING
    VALUE(iv_part)     TYPE string
    VALUE(iv_formname) TYPE tdsfname OPTIONAL
    VALUE(iv_name)     TYPE string OPTIONAL
    VALUE(iv_object)   TYPE string OPTIONAL
    VALUE(iv_id)       TYPE string OPTIONAL
    VALUE(iv_btype)    TYPE string OPTIONAL
    VALUE(iv_language) TYPE spras OPTIONAL
  EXPORTING
    VALUE(ev_subrc)   TYPE sysubrc
    VALUE(ev_message) TYPE string
    VALUE(ev_result)  TYPE string.

* ZMCP_SSF_CONTENT - read-only: SmartForm content for preview rendering.
*
* Function group ZMCP_ADT_UTILS, NOT remote-enabled - ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH
* action SSF_CONTENT calls it (MCP tool GetSmartFormContent). One source
* for BASIS 7.31 and 7.40: no inline declarations, no NEW / VALUE / CONV /
* COND, no /UI2/CL_JSON, no ZCL_MCP_JSON - the JSON is built here.
* Uses FORM SSF_LAYOUT_STR of ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT (same function group).
*
* IV_PART
*   FORM     whole form as Form Builder XML (FB_CONVERT_FORM_TO_XML: active
*            version, texts in the logon language - the same XML as
*            transaction SMARTFORMS > Utilities > Download).
*            IV_FORMNAME. Result {"form","language","xml"} - xml in base64.
*   STYLE    SmartStyle as CSS (SSF_CONVERT_STYLE_TO_CSS, UTF-8).
*            IV_NAME = style. Result {"style","css"} - css in base64.
*   GRAPHIC  SE78 graphic as BMP (SAPSCRIPT_GET_GRAPHIC_BDS +
*            SAPSCRIPT_CONVERT_BITMAP) plus its STXBITMAPS size data.
*            IV_OBJECT (default GRAPHICS), IV_NAME, IV_ID (default BMAP),
*            IV_BTYPE (default BCOL). Result {"object","name","id","btype",
*            "widthPix","heightPix","widthTw","heightTw","resolution",
*            "bmp"} - bmp in base64.
*   STDTEXT  SO10 / include text (READ_TEXT). IV_OBJECT (default TEXT),
*            IV_NAME, IV_ID (default ST), IV_LANGUAGE (default logon).
*            Result {"object","name","id","language","lines":[{"f","l"}]}.
*
* The standard wrappers CL_SSF_XSF_UTILITIES=>GET_BDS_GRAPHIC_AS_BMP and
* GET_SMART_STYLE_AS_CSS are NOT used: they MODIFY the cache tables
* SSFXSFBMP / SSFXSFCSS. This FM never writes.
*
*   EV_SUBRC  0 ok, 4 not found, 8 other error (EV_MESSAGE)

  DATA: lv_part    TYPE string,
        lv_str     TYPE string,
        lv_xml     TYPE xstring,
        lv_b64     TYPE string,
        lv_j1      TYPE string,
        lv_j2      TYPE string,
        lv_j3      TYPE string,
        lv_j4      TYPE string,
        lv_obj     TYPE tdobjectgr,
        lv_gname   TYPE tdobname,
        lv_gid     TYPE tdidgr,
        lv_btype   TYPE tdbtype,
        lv_bytes   TYPE i,
        lv_len     TYPE i,
        lv_linelen TYPE i,
======
* ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH - action SSF_CONTENT (MCP tool GetSmartFormContent).
*
* NOT a standalone object. Two snippets to paste into the LIVE dispatcher
* of the target system - never deploy the repo copies of the dispatchers
* (zmcp_adt_dispatch_731.abap / zmcp_adt_dispatch_ecc.abap may be older
* than the system). Read and back up the live source first.
*
* Prerequisite: FM ZMCP_SSF_CONTENT (abap/zmcp_ssf_content.abap) exists and
* is active in function group ZMCP_ADT_UTILS, next to ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT (it
* uses FORM ssf_layout_str of that FM). Install it before the branch.
*
* params: part (FORM | STYLE | GRAPHIC | STDTEXT), form_name, name, object,
*         id, btype, language (1-char SAP key or 2-char ISO code)
* result: EV_RESULT of ZMCP_SSF_CONTENT unchanged (hand-built JSON)
* subrc : 0 ok, 4 not found, 8 other error - EV_MESSAGE says why


*======================================================================*
* SNIPPET A - BASIS 7.31 dispatcher (ZCL_MCP_JSON, no 7.40 syntax)
*======================================================================*
* A1. In the CASE iv_action of FUNCTION zmcp_adt_dispatch, insert before
*     WHEN OTHERS:
*
*        WHEN 'SSF_CONTENT'.
*          PERFORM ssf_content USING iv_params

**Sources:**

**Interface of ZMCP_SSF_CONTENT:**
| Parameter | Type | Direction | Description |
|-----------|------|-----------|-------------|
| IV_PART | STRING | Import | \`FORM\`, \`STYLE\`, \`GRAPHIC\` or \`STDTEXT\` |
| IV_FORMNAME | TDSFNAME | Import (optional) | SmartForm name (\`FORM\`) |
| IV_NAME | STRING | Import (optional) | Style, graphic or text name |
| IV_OBJECT / IV_ID / IV_BTYPE | STRING | Import (optional) | Graphic key (defaults \`GRAPHICS\` / \`BMAP\` / \`BCOL\`) or text key (\`TEXT\` / \`ST\`) |
| IV_LANGUAGE | SPRAS | Import (optional) | Include text language; empty → logon language |
| EV_SUBRC | SYSUBRC | Export | 0 = ok, 4 = not found, 8 = other error |
| EV_MESSAGE | STRING | Export | Error / info message |

`);
